title: 橡胶涟漪
style: soft yellow bath-toy rubber, matte molded seams, shallow pale-blue water stage
beats: The yellow face floats and bobs gently
The orange cheek puffs out a single round bubble
The bubble touches the water and makes a ring ripple
The ripple expands around the face
The bubble rises back toward the cheek
The face settles at its starting waterline
